prompts.name: vivian
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent-background square chibi bust avatar of Vivian / 薇薇安 from Zenless Zone Zero. Input image 1 is the definitive character identity and costume reference, not a pose to copy. Input image 2 is ONLY the drawing style reference: use the illustrated character inside that phone screenshot, ignore all phone UI, black rectangle and white margins. Match its extremely large rounded head, small bust, heavy clean dark outline, very simple flat cel shading, large half-lidded round eyes with simple white highlights, tiny nearly invisible mouth, faint blush, adorably blank/dazed expression. Head and gaze point gently toward IMAGE LEFT with a slight head tilt, not toward image right. Preserve Vivian's pale lavender long voluminous curled hair with silvery pale front streak, curled ahoge, dark feather/wing-like head ornaments and ribbon, red/crimson eyes, subtly pointed ears, white ruffled blouse with puff sleeves and black/lavender bow and small jewel at collar. Simplify her costume exactly from image 1; no maid cap from the style reference, no invented crown or bat ears. Just head, hair and upper torso; head takes about 75% of silhouette, curled locks flow around shoulders. Calm slightly aloof but cute, not crying or seductive. Clean sticker-quality transparent PNG, no text, no border, no frame, no logo, no props obscuring the face. Character centered and fully within canvas with 8% breathing room, crisp and legible as a small chat avatar.

prompts.name: hugo
prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE transparent-background square chibi bust avatar of Hugo / 雨果 from Zenless Zone Zero. Input image 1 is the definitive identity reference. Input image 2 is ONLY the style reference, use its illustrated character and ignore all phone UI, black rectangle and white margins. Recreate its big rounded head, tiny bust, clean thick dark outlines, simple flat cel shading, large half-lidded round eyes with simple white highlights, faint blush, tiny neutral mouth, adorably blank/dazed expression. Head and gaze point gently toward IMAGE LEFT, slightly tilted, not right. Preserve Hugo's golden blond hair, asymmetric side-swept fringe, spiky curled top forelock, long low ponytail tied behind the neck that falls over a shoulder, subtly pointed ears. Heterochromia: character's OWN RIGHT eye is pale green (viewer-left in a frontal view), OWN LEFT eye is red (viewer-right in a frontal view); keep correct anatomical eyes as head turns. Outfit from input 1: navy/dark blue tailored coat, violet blue high collared shirt, pale lavender patterned tie, gold and silver coin-like chest medallions linked by a fine chain. He is a male elegant phantom thief, no beard, no hat, no monocle, no maid headband, no horns, no white hair, no red coat. Only head/hair/upper torso; head about 75% of silhouette; keep ponytail visible enough to identify. Same small chibi proportion as the style input, neutral soft dumbfounded stare with a hint of composure. Center with 8% transparent padding, crisp sticker quality, no text, no decorative frame or background.
